decision_conditions:
1.	Installation in Accordance with Approved Assessment
The air conditioning units shall be installed and operated only in full accordance with the details and noise mitigation measures set out in the submitted Acoustic Report Ref: 25060 002 (Philip Acoustics Ltd, December 2025). No substitution of plant shall take place unless details have first been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority to demonstrate continued compliance with the above noise criterion.

2.	Vibration Isolation
All external air conditioning units shall be mounted on suitable proprietary anti vibration isolators, in accordance with manufacturer’s recommendations, prior to first use and thereafter retained whilst the air conditioning units are in use.

3.	Maintenance
The air conditioning units shall be appropriately serviced and maintained in accordance with the manufacturer’s instructions to ensure that noise emissions do not increase beyond the approved levels.

REASON: To protect the amenities of neighbouring occupiers.
